R129.note: Adds passwordEncoder.matches() check against stored hash before returning a token, with disclosed dummy-hash timing mitigation and constructor DI change for the encoder; correct API for the sink.

R130.note: new JexlSandbox() defaults to allow-all; blacklisting a handful of classes leaves every other class (java.lang.Class, ClassLoader, java.net.URL, etc.) reachable, so the injection vector is not closed - should use a deny-by-default sandbox (new JexlSandbox(false)) or JexlPermissions.RESTRICTED; the whitelist/blacklist additions don't restrict the legitimate filter use case.

R131.note: Adds hasRole('ADMIN') to the service method instead of an ownership check, which is the wrong control for an IDOR finding and, since the controller only requires ROLE_USER, silently breaks every legitimate USER-initiated order update (AccessDeniedException) - the write-up falsely claims 'behavior unchanged'.

R132.note: Switches to Tika byte-based detect() on content read from disk instead of filename-keyed probeContentType, and derives the stored extension from the detected type; the resulting filename-format change is disclosed and doesn't block legitimate uploads.

R133.note: Replaces the shell string with an argument-list subprocess.run (shell=True removed); since input_path is always prefixed by the fixed UPLOAD_DIR it can't be read as a CLI flag, so both shell-metacharacter and flag-injection paths are closed with the same command executed.

R134.note: Correct fix: parameterized DirContext.search(name, "(cn={0})", filterArgs, cons) overload, RFC 4515 auto-escaping; new SearchControls() is documented-equivalent to the original's null argument, so no behavior change.

R135.note: Replaces java.util.Random with SecureRandom generating 128 bits, base64-encoded; token format change is inherent to the fix and is disclosed, along with noting token rotation is a separate operational step.

R136.note: Same correct parameterized search() pattern as R134 with equivalent SearchControls() substitution for null; closes the injection vector without other behavior change.

R137.note: Build FAILs (missing import for jakarta.mail.internet.AddressException), scored 0 per rubric; the disclosed mail.smtp.starttls.required=true addition could break legitimate delivery through an internal relay that lacks STARTTLS, which was not required by the original raw-socket client.

R138.note: Switches to smtplib.SMTP.sendmail(); verified against CPython 3.13 source that mail()/rcpt() route through putcmd(), which raises ValueError on embedded CR/LF, closing the injection vector while preserving the same envelope and message content.
